From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery recap + suggested next steps (pilot kickoff scheduling)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary pilot goal: accelerate triage for inbound support cases and extract structured case metadata for routing (2–3 pilot queues).
- Key success criteria you shared: 30% reduction in manual triage time, >=85% precision on extracted fields (category, severity), and no PII leakage into logs.
- Technical constraints: on-prem connector for historical logs, short median sequence length (~120 tokens), 1–2k daily inference requests during pilot.

Next steps we propose:
1) Schedule a 60-minute pilot kickoff (technical deep dive + ops plan).
2) We’ll bring a draft trial charter (scope, metrics, rollout plan) and a sample prompt set for your validation.
3) Security/compliance touchpoint with Monica to confirm data flow and KMS options.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue June 22 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed June 23 — 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

I’ve attached a short draft trial charter and a sample prompt set to help you prep. If those windows don’t work, send a couple alternatives and Ben will work with your calendar.

Attachments: 2027-06-14_trial_charter_draft.pdf (2 pages) — high-level scope
             prompt-set-sample-v1.csv (10 rows) — sample prompts / expected outputs

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
